name: Indirect Structural Certification
description: Replaces the explicit tree definitions ("exactly one valid sequence") with their indirect graph-theoretic equivalents ("fully integrated" and "minimally sufficient"). The numeric bound m = n - 1 is preserved but framed as a mathematical consequence of these properties rather than a primary rule. This forces models to deduce the tree structure from first principles rather than pattern-matching the exact phrasing to immediately deploy rooted-tree algorithms.
